lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur gaaeeai aatam ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: Sing the Praises of the Lord and Master, with the love of your soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saranee paavan naam dhiaavan sahaj samaavan sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who seek His Sanctuary, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are blended with the Lord in celestial peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan ke charan vasahi merai heearai sa(n)g puneetaa dehee ||
lines.translation: The feet of the Lord's humble servant abide in my heart; with them, my body is made pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਏਹੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan kee dhoor dehu kirapaa nidh naanak kai sukh ehee ||2||4||35||
lines.translation: O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your humble servants; this alone brings peace. ||2||4||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jatan karai maanukh dahakaavai ohu a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||
lines.translation: People try to deceive others, but the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paap kare kar mookar paavai bhekh karai nirabaanai ||1||
lines.translation: They commit sins, and then deny them, while they pretend to be in Nirvaanaa. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaanat door tumahi prabh ner ||
lines.translation: They believe that You are far away, but You, O God, are near at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਤ ਤਾਕੈ ਉਤ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਪੇਖੈ ਆਵੈ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੇਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ut taakai ut te ut pekhai aavai lobhee pher || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Looking around, this way and that, the greedy people come and go. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਾ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag tutai naahee man bharamaa tab lag mukat na koee ||
lines.translation: As long as the doubts of the mind are not removed, liberation is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak daiaal suaamee sa(n)t bhagat jan soee ||2||5||36||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, he alone is a Saint, a devotee, and a humble servant of the Lord, to whom the Lord and Master is merciful. ||2||5||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam gur deeo hai apunai jaa kai masatak karamaa ||
lines.translation: My Guru gives the Naam, the Name of the Lord, to those who have such karma written on their foreheads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam driRaavai naam japaavai taa kaa jug mahi dharamaa ||1||
lines.translation: He implants the Naam, and inspires us to chant the Naam; this is Dharma, true religion, in this world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸੋਭ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kau naam vadaaee sobh ||
lines.translation: The Naam is the glory and greatness of the Lord's humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamo gat naamo pat jan kee maanai jo jo hog ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Naam is his salvation, and the Naam is his honor; he accepts whatever comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhan jis jan kai paalai soee pooraa saahaa ||
lines.translation: That humble servant, who has the Naam as his wealth, is the perfect banker.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: naam biuhaaraa naanak aadhaaraa naam paraapat laahaa ||2||6||37||
lines.translation: The Naam is his occupation, O Nanak, and his only support; the Naam is the profit he earns. ||2||6||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਦਰਸ ਪੇਖੇ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਰਉ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: netr puneet bhae daras pekhe maathai parau ravaal ||
lines.translation: My eyes have been purified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and touching my forehead to the dust of His feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਮੋਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ras ras gun gaavau thaakur ke morai hiradai basahu gopaal ||1||
lines.translation: With joy and happiness, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master; the Lord of the World abides within my heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਤਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum tau raakhanahaar daiaal ||
lines.translation: You are my Merciful Protector, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar sughar bea(n)t pitaa prabh hohu prabhoo kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O beautiful, wise, infinite Father God, be Merciful to me, God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d ma(n)gal roop tumare bachan anoop rasaal ||
lines.translation: O Lord of supreme ecstasy and blissful form, Your Word is so beautiful, so drenched with Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਣ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai charan sabad satigur ko naanak baa(n)dhio paal ||2||7||38||
lines.translation: With the Lord's lotus feet enshrined in his heart, Nanak has tied the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, to the hem of his robe. ||2||7||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖੇਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanee ukat khalaavai bhojan apanee ukat khelaavai ||
lines.translation: In His own way, He provides us with our food; in His own way, He plays with us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh bhog ras devai man hee naal samaavai ||1||
lines.translation: He blesses us with all comforts, enjoyments and delicacies, and he permeates our minds. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamare pitaa gopaal daiaal ||
lines.translation: Our Father is the Lord of the World, the Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu raakhai mahataaree baarik kau taise hee prabh paal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Just as the mother protects her children, God nurtures and cares for us. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet saajan sarab gun naaik sadaa salaamat devaa ||
lines.translation: You are my friend and companion, the Master of all excellences, O eternal and permanent Divine Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: eet oot jat kat tat tum hee milai naanak sa(n)t sevaa ||2||8||39||
lines.translation: Here, there and everywhere, You are pervading; please, bless Nanak to serve the Saints. ||2||8||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t kripaal daiaal damodar kaam krodh bikh jaare ||
lines.translation: The Saints are kind and compassionate; they burn away their sexual desire, anger and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਇਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਲੈ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raaj maal joban tan jeearaa in oopar lai baare ||1||
lines.translation: My power, wealth, youth, body and soul are a sacrifice to them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan raam naam hitakaare ||
lines.translation: With my mind and body, I love the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਹਿਤ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ma(n)gal sahit bhav nidh paar utaare || rahaau ||
lines.translation: With peace, poise, pleasure and joy, He has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||
